title: Service catalog entry
description: One service in the resident service catalog: one YAML file per service, services/<slug>.yaml in the data pack. Read by catalog_loader.load_services into app.models.Service. Cross-file rules (unique id/slug, category references, location service_id, ...) are enforced by app/services/pack_validator.py, not by this schema. Contract index: config/schemas/index.json; field reference: docs/DATA_PACK.md.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the service, by convention svc-<slug> (for example svc-age). Never reuse or change once published.

slug.description: URL-safe unique name, lowercase words joined by hyphens. Must match the file name.

name.description: Public name of the service or program.

description.description: Plain-language summary of what the service provides. Plain text, no HTML or Markdown.

eligibility_summary.description: Plain-language statement of who qualifies. Required so residents are never shown a service without knowing who it is for. Its first sentence is quoted in the 'Check eligibility' note.

eligibility_requires.description: Hard eligibility gates the matching engine checks against the resident profile (app/services/eligibility.py). All listed gates must be satisfied.

how_to_apply.description: Steps a resident takes to get the service.

cost.description: Plain-language description of cost to the resident.

cost_type.description: Machine-readable cost category. Defaults to free when absent.

website_url.description: Public web page for the service, an http(s):// URL. May be empty if none exists (validator warns).

phone.description: Main contact phone. A service must have this or at least one location phone.

languages_offered.description: Language codes (ISO 639-1, or a BCP 47 tag such as zh-Hant) the service can be delivered in. Defaults to [en] when absent.

accessibility_features.description: Accessibility features, for example Wheelchair accessible.

status.description: Whether the service is currently offered. inactive services are never listed or matched.

categories.description: Category slugs (the slug field in categories.yaml, for example healthcare). At least one. Validity against categories.yaml is checked by the validator.

locations.description: Physical sites. May be empty for phone-only or online-only services.

documents.description: Documents a resident should bring or submit.

last_verified_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) a person last confirmed this entry against the provider. Optional; absent means unverified. Not read by the server yet (the loader drops it). Never set by a tool or AI agent.

verified_by.description: Role or team (not a personal name) that last verified this entry. Optional; absent means unverified. Not read by the server yet (the loader drops it). Never set by a tool or AI agent.

provider_type.description: Jurisdiction level of the provider. Optional. Not read by the server yet (the loader drops it).

sources.description: Where the facts in this entry came from. Optional. Not read by the server yet (the loader drops it).

x-message: no contact phone: set top-level phone or a phone on at least one location

is_required.description: True if the document is mandatory. Defaults to true.

id.description: Location identifier, unique across the pack, by convention loc-<slug>-<n>. A missing id gets a random one at each start, so always set it.

service_id.description: Must equal the parent service id (checked by the validator).

name.description: Site name, for example Main Campus.

zip_code.description: ZIP code as a quoted string.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Must not be 0: the map and radius search skip a location with a zero coordinate.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Must not be 0.

is_primary.description: True for the main site. At most one per service.

hours.description: Opening hours keyed by lowercase day name. Values app/services/hours.py understands: 'H:MM AM - H:MM PM' (hyphen, en dash or em dash; minutes optional), 'Closed', or text containing '24' and 'hour' (24 hours). A missing day means closed. Anything else reads as closed (validator warns).

hours_verified.description: True only if a person confirmed these hours with the provider. Never set true by a tool or AI agent.

url.description: Page the facts came from, an http(s):// URL.

fields.description: Service fields this source supports, for example [phone, hours].
